reviewer: Kimi actual visual comparison of exact native source, complete unchanged native RGBA, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged mascot reference

entries.positive_observation: Dark navy cap with gold front insignia and gold visor leaves, graying temple hair and pale eyebrows remain. The face stays smooth without a broad moustache or beard and has one serious closed mouth. Dark navy jacket, white shirt, dark tie and paired pale collar tabs are retained, with a short broad fitted neck and no long stalk, clipping or cream bib. The complete tilted frame, muted opaque photographic backing, overlapping warm-cream note with compact upper marks and mostly blank lower paper, and small dark right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte halo.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the native transparent exterior and actual RGBA; no source-alpha replacement was needed. White/cyan inspection, not alpha numbers alone, found no visible holes or backing loss.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine upper-lip hair and tiny cap/collar insignia are not reliably readable at 65x67; no broad facial hair or new emblem was invented. Existing indistinct note groups remain compact rather than newly readable text.
